faqs.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Answers to common questions about our services and premium support experience.

items.question: What types of websites do you develop?
items.answer: We specialize in developing business websites, e-commerce platforms, educational websites, and custom digital solutions. Every project is tailored to your goals, from design to deployment.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: The timeline for website development depends on the complexity and features required. Typically, a basic website can take 2-4 weeks, while more complex projects may take 6-8 weeks or longer.

items.question: Do you provide website maintenance and support?
items.answer: Yes, we offer ongoing maintenance and support services to ensure your website remains up-to-date, secure, and running smoothly after launch.

items.question: How do I get started with my project?
items.answer: You can get in touch with us through our contact page by sending an email or starting a WhatsApp chat. We'll discuss your project requirements and guide you through the next steps.
